request.state:
L01: The status service answers one request and nothing else.
L02: It reports whether the queue drained in the last minute.
L03: It listens on port 8411 on the loopback address alone.
L04: A request from another host is refused before it is read.
L05: The answer is a single line of plain text.
L06: The word ready means the queue drained.
L07: The word behind means it did not.
L08: No other word is ever printed.
L09: The service keeps no state between requests.
L10: It is started by the supervisor and never by hand.
L11: A failure to start is written to the supervisor log.

q1.instructions: Which line gives the network port the status service listens on?
